[quote=enkia;60005852][b][i]UFO SIGHTINGS INCREASED DURRING WAR TIME[/i][/b]

As The war over the fate of [nation]Sikirsk[/nation] rages on, there have been some strange reports coming in from their capital, and this entrepid reporter went all the way out to investigate.
UFO sightings have been a thing for as long as there  have been people to look up and not be sure of what it is they're looking at. From flying saucers to the strange historical phenomenon of people spotting blue police boxes through out history, you'll be hard pressed to find anyone who takes these claims seriously.
However, the timing of these sightings has many considering more mundane, albeit more gruesome theories. Bomber planes, or electronic warfare platforms have been kicked around.
I had gone down in hopes of catching sight of one myself, but I wasn't able to. Though I did feel the hostility rising from the people of Nestor Sikirsk. This war has left many people agitated, scared, and hopeless for the future. Perhaps a silly story about space aliens will help, though my editor still questions the news worthiness of this story...

[quote=united_hydronia;60011227][spoiler=[b]defending[/b]]
After failure to intercept the majority of the missiles, the ornate squadron would be rerouted to the east to aid in defending the skies during the ongoing landing. Small air defence systems situated at Military targets would fire surface-to-air interceptors at the Donnerkeil missiles as they approached, hoping to minimise damage, but oil refineries and other infrastructure would take heavy hits.

Jamming and chaff spraying would be employed to help protect the Hydronians against the incoming missiles. As the jets took evasive action, jamming would attempt to disable the missiles and chaff would attempt to confuse their radar. As the submarines in the water continued to take down the Kaiserreichs fleet, the missiles would become less and less accurate due to less information inputs. These tactics would be employed to deal with both rounds of missiles simultaneously, but at least 2 jets would be downed.

Despite appearing like a ridiculous idea, these acoustic-guided missiles are more useful than they seem. Due to their already close proximity to the drones when being released, it is far easier for them to lock onto them. This is greatly aided by the incredibly sensitive fine tuning of the sensors. Whilst this is still an experimental technology, it does have its uses.

The Mach 6 missiles high manoeuvrability due to light weight and thrust nozzles would allow them to avoid the interceptors relatively easily. Their ability to reaccelerate would then come into play. Once it had avoided the interceptors it would lock back onto the jets with their laser homing and speed back up to Mach 6 to quickly take down the jets.

The Kaiserreich used ATTs to attempt to cover their fleet from the submarine attacks, but they would not be so successful. Due to the torpedoes being launched almost directly underneath the  kaiserreichs ships, the torpedoes would be very hard to intercept. They essentially used the technocratic fleet as cover from their own weapons and sonars. The window to detect and launch interceptors is very small from such proximity and so it would be difficult for the Kaiserreich to launch ATTs quick enough and accurately enough. Most of the torpedoes would continue towards their targets as the submarines continued their tactics of staying deep in the water to avoid detection, then rising up directly underneath ships to release their payload, before diving back down into the depths of the North Sea.

The enemy torpedoes would be dealt with by Hydronias ATTs. The enemy subs would be dealt with by the same torpedoes used to destroy the fleet. The submarines would fire small, agile torpedoes towards the swarming UUVs, whilst taking evasive action. These torpedoes would work to intercept the swarm, whilst using jamming tactics to misguide the UUVs.

The highly sensitive mines would be set off by even the slightest pressure change. Some of the mines would be set off as the UUVs approached them, but others would end up being safely dismantled, allowing the ship through. The Radar would take heavy hits, with nearly all of it being disabled. This wouldnt concern the Hydronians too much however as they had already served their purpose.

Despite small fire doing nothing to the AAVs, Hydronias firework-3400 man-portable missile launchers would be employed to destroy the approaching AAVs and other armoured vehicles. Huge numbers of these missiles would be fired towards the landing party, it would be impossible to intercept them all. The firework-3400s would also be loaded with small interceptor missiles. Multitudes of these would be fired towards the Donnerkeils to help protect the troops as well as into the sky against the jets. The JDAMs and cluster bombs would do heavy damage to the Hydronian infantry. The machine gunners and snipers would be able to take cover behind hills to avoid the incoming fire.

Since the missiles failed to deal significant damage to the LCACs, the machine gunners up in the hills would be given orders to also target the LCACs.

The missiles would continue to fire at the AAVs. Huge numbers of the missiles would be used to overwhelm the enemy. They couldnt all be intercepted. Due to the portable nature of the missile launchers, they would be moved behind the protective hills before anything could hit them. They would continue to fire from behind the hills.

The Kaiserreich jets had reacted too late. Air-to-air missiles were already well on their way towards the jets. Interceptors open up on the Hydronian missiles, but due to their relative cheapness compared to hypersonic missiles, huge barrages of then would be fired to exhaust the enemy of their interception capabilities. The jets would take evasive action whilst using jamming devices to avoid the enemys attempts to take them down.

The Kaiserreichs supply lines had so far seemed unstoppable, but Hydronias earlier mentioned submarine tactics would deal with that. As new ships approached the speedy submarines would begin targeting them too, launching barrages of torpedoes from underneath.

The countermeasures against the missiles would do a good job for the most part, except for one major flaw. The size of the aircraft compared to the missiles would allow them to continue in the same direction and hit the aircraft, despite the lack of targeting capabilities. Damage would be lower than the Hydronians wished, but it would still hinder the Kaiserreich.

[i]- BEFORE THE LANDING -[/i]

Spotting the paratroopers as they jumped would prove difficult due to the time of day, but the machine gunners had adopted a tactic of simply spraying bullets throughout the air to maximise the amount of troops they could stop before they hit the ground. The high number of machine gunners present would allow this tactic to work well, with bullets filling the night sky. Any soldiers who landed in unintended areas would be shot on sight to swiftly eliminate any threat they posed. As the enemy troops used their vehicles to quickly attempt to sabotage Hydronian targets, they would be stopped. As they approached airfields and other locations, huge numbers of Hydronian troops would be waiting. Earlier, Hydronian scouts had spotted the helicopters and both notified the machine gunners and nearby bases similar. The Hydronian numbers would be able to quickly surround and overwhelm the small in comparison Kaiserreich teams.
[/spoiler]

[b]The Claws begin to move[/b]

As the situation with TK continued to develop quite poorly with Hydronia, the 1st fleet, having arrived in Thývens Shamat territories three days after their deployment from mainland Thýven would leave Shamat for the waters of Hydronia, replenished, and now fueled. These ships would carry various rockets and drones upon them, and would be expected to make sight of Hydronia within two more days.

Thus, as a result of a concern for the security of Hydronia, the F-16s, having landed in Shamat a day before the 1st fleet, would make their way to Hydronia, moving quickly as guide planes for Thývens Rockwell B-1 Lancers, of which would consist of two wings worth to begin nighttime aerial bombardments of the front lines of TK and Hydronia, aiming to destroy logistical and supply chains on TKs side. 

In the meantime the 2nd fleet, having stopped in the White Strait for a day, would finally leave the White Strait and turn northwards towards the North-West and continuing onwards. At the same time the 3rd fleet would pass 400 miles off the coast of Jomsland heading towards the Northern Ice Sheet. 

As this was ongoing, the government of Thýven was under debate on whether pre-emptive drone and missile strikes against strategic points on the mainland of TK were feasible, with most of the armed forces heads in favour of launching strikes. However, king Erjk Drs, wanting to avoid rapid escalation on Elesyr, would deny the strikes from occurring, instead opting to wait to see how they responded to the aerial strikes in Hydronia.

[b]THE TREATY OF NESTOR ISLAND AS SIGNED BY [nation]Enkia[/nation] AND [nation]Sikirsk[/nation][/b]

The High Council of Covens and the ruling government of Sikirsk wish to put aside any and all previous differences and grievances aside, and in this document seeks to rectify said grievances while also furthering the economic benefit of all nations involved. The following articles have been drafted and debated upon, and both nations fully accept and agree to, with the acceptance and approval of all peoples.
This Treaty shall be a major step forward in an era of progress for all the people of Nestor Island, as this allows for more free trade and expansion for both nations as Enkia seeks to cover more ground for its people, and Sikirsk searches for more allies as the war intensifies.
 This Document was signed on July 28th, 2025 in the Enkian Capital of Astarte, in the Astaroth Pyramid Assembly building. 

[b]ARTICLE 1[/b]
As issued via telegram on the 20th of July;
"Sikirsk hereby seeks reserves of "iron" from Enkia, to be supplied via military vehicles, and delivered by military personnel. This practice is to be followed by both nations to ensure the safety and security of our transactions." The following terms were amended by the nation of Enkia in another telegram; "In exchange for this mutual share, a seceding of land  equal to 94,450 square kilometers (3,778 pixels) south of Nestor-Sikirsk. With the assurance that our new coast line will be defended and maintained."
On the 28th of July, these terms were agreed upon by both nations. The new borders await international approval, and will see Enkia become a coastal nation. Further, Enkia has made provisions to allow the Sikirskians 4 year visas to sell their homes and return to Nestor Sikirsk or Sikirsk with all travel expenses paid for, as well as being willing to purchase any remaining homes for current market value at the exact time of purchase. A private real estate agency of Enkian Blood also put out a special loan for low income sirkiskians, offering them housing cost assistance in their homeland.

[b]ARTICLE 2[/b]
In a further telegram on july 22nd the following article was laid by the sikirskian leadership;
"As stewards on both ends of this island, an alliance of nations is in order. To ensure mutual protection, economic growth and prosperity amongst our people. Further, an oath to no aggressive acts on either side must be made, to ensure peace on Nestor Island." Enkia agreed to these terms earnestly, and orders to de-arm and open the north border will be made on the signing of this treaty that the article is a part of. Further; Should either the nation of Sikirsk or Enkia break the non aggression pact, the victim is legally responsible to seek international help in condemning the perpetrator as a War Criminal.

[b]ARTICLE 3[/b]
In further pledges of support, Enkia will no longer use the name 'Enestor' to refer to the island, adopting the Sikirskian name of "Nestor Island" in all official documentation as of July 28th, 2025. A new natural gas pipeline connecting the Berith Natural Gas Line, into the sikirskian network. sikirskians may also apply for dual citizenship in Enkia. Travel between the nations we feel should be free to flow. As this conflict grows we shall also be sending arms and ammunition to the brave soldiers of Sikirsk who fight to defend Nestor Island. Further, we openly condemn and embargo all nations who have declared war on Sikirsk. For all our Nation's life Nestor-Sikirsk has been by our side, and now we stand by theirs. They have as much right to be here as we do, and as Satan and all the Demons in Hell as our witnesses, We shall defend their right to exist, and defend our island until the last blade of grass has died in Enkia. Plans and actions will be considered and developed to further support Sikirsk in protecting themselves from aggressive nations. This will include strengthening our own military, and forming new branches as this new land affords us opportunities to do so. This new Era for our Nations shall be one of mutual growth and help. By working together, Nestor Island will become a world class destination, and all shall feel the beautiful light of Humanity in Co-operation. We hope this to be an example of the unity that can be achieved through diplomacy rather than violence.

Signed by
The High Priest Malchadorus Fione and the High Council of Covens.
The Sikirskian leadership.

(OOC: Expansion post! In a grand land deal Enkia has allied in exchange for land, and we will be providing more as the weeks come to pass :0 )
